newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodia party to nominate foreign minister for PM.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia party to nominate foreign minister for PM.

text.p: A dissident faction of ousted First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh's FUNCINPEC party said on Wednesday it would nominate Foreign Minister Ung Huot as the prince's replacement.
The leader of the dissident faction, Toan Chay, who had been tipped to replace Ranariddh as Hun Sen's co-premier, told reporters he could not take the job because he was not a member of parliament.
"We have already proposed Ung Huot to be prime minster, we completely agree with each other," Toan Chay told reporters, referring to the rump of Ranariddh's party that remains in the country.

Second Prime Minister Hun Sen overthrew Ranariddh on July 6 but said he wanted the coalition between his Cambodian People's Party and FUNCINPEC to remain in place and for the royalist party to choose a new first prime minister to replace Ranariddh.

Toan Chay said Ung Huot's name would be forwarded to the National Assembly when it reopened later this month. He said he could not be first prime minister because the constitution required that the post be filled by a member of parliament.
"I can't accept the premiership because ... I am not a member of parliament. I am only the governor of a province, and His Majesty the King asked that the constitution not be amended," he said.
